evals.prompt: Audit the notification scheduling feature in this mobile app. I want to know whether changing the time really persists and reschedules correctly after restart.
assertions: Keeps scope on notification scheduling and its direct dependencies
Defines falsifiable persistence and scheduling promises
Traces UI, state, persistence, native scheduling, and refresh behavior
Requires controlled runtime scenarios for restart and schedule replacement
Separates simulator, physical-device, and real-delivery proof

evals.prompt: Can you audit whether our checkout entitlement screen is actually working?
assertions: Does not implement fixes without explicit repair authorization
Checks client display against authoritative entitlement state
Exercises failure, pending, cancelled, refunded, and account-switch states
Reports severity, confidence, and evidence level separately

evals.prompt: Audit the profile save flow, fix every confirmed Critical or High issue, and prove the fixes.
assertions: Adds a regression oracle before or with the fix
Reruns the original failure scenario after the fix
Distinguishes fixed locally from deployed or released

evals.prompt: Audit whether our legal case contacts feature correctly models clients, opposing parties, counsel, witnesses, and the court.
assertions: Separates entities, roles, relationships, perspective, and neutral actors
Traces relationships into readiness, prompts, exports, and proofs
Tests invalid cross-scope and role-incompatible relationships
